prompt:
Reconcile a synthetic multi-desk portfolio immediately after the March2023 Credit Suisse AT1 write-down under the FINMA instruction and the issuer's announced UBS share exchange. This is a historical conditional mark and treasury exercise, not a current2026 legal valuation or prediction of litigation. DeskA directly holds CHF1,000,000 AT1 face carried at80% of par. DeskB holds a separate wrapper whose only economic asset is CHF1,500,000 of the SAME Credit Suisse AT1 exposure carried at70%; wrapper pass-through is exact and has no fees, cash or other assets. Apply a zero immediate AT1 mark under the stipulated write-down event. The equity book owns22,480 Credit Suisse shares acquired at CHF2 each, and separately is short1,000 UBS shares entered at CHF20. Mark eventual UBS delivery and that short at a synthetic CHF18 per UBS share; assume the contractual announced exchange occurs on its stated terms. Another book owns CHF1,000,000 Tier2 face, carried at95% and independently supplied with a92% post-event market mark. Treat all marks as CHF, with no FX, taxes or other positions. Treasury has CHF120,000 cash. A synthetic collateral agreement demands an immediate cash margin payment equal to50% of the aggregate AT1 mark loss. The UBS short gain is cash-settled and available immediately; the equity exchange consideration is delivered later in shares, with no early cash conversion, asset sales, close-out netting or additional inflows. Determine shared-issuer loss, eventual share exposure, aggregate mark P&L and immediate cash financing. Then withhold only the Tier2 post-event market mark and assess whether aggregate P&L remains identified; distinguish regulatory write-down scope from market valuation and later legal recovery.

Use the supplied historical documents as specified; this packet is a retrospective conditional analysis with observed 2026 source availability, not a claim of contemporaneous historical execution. Return typed outputs with supporting verbatim clauses; declared support_dependencies permit explicit support_refs to reuse previously justified answers. Synthetic inputs need no invented citation.

output_fields.description: Positive aggregate mark loss on both direct and look-through AT1 holdings.
Eventual contractual UBS shares for the stated Credit Suisse equity position.
Equity merger-entitlement mark minus Credit Suisse share acquisition cost.
UBS delivery plus the pre-existing signed UBS hedge position.
Total P&L against the explicitly stated baselines: AT1/Tier2 carrying marks and equity/short acquisition or entry cost. This is not a pure event-day return.
Additional cash needed now to meet the stated margin call after available treasury cash and cash-settled hedge gain.
Does the FINMA write-down instruction require marking this Tier2 bond to zero?
If the supplied Tier2 post-event market mark is withheld, do the regulatory and merger documents determine the aggregate portfolio mark P&L?
Do these event documents settle the ultimate amount or timing of any later litigation or recovery proceeds?
